evals.name: bootstrap-existing-service-repository
evals.prompt: Replace the root agent instructions for this established service. Inspect enough of the supplied repository evidence to identify durable project rules, create the smallest useful AGENTS.md, and make Claude use the same source without duplication.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes a compact, evidence-backed root AGENTS.md focused on payout invariants and verification, writes the exact CLAUDE.md import, validates the pair, and explains material replacement decisions.

assertions.text: Inspects the supplied purpose, domain, flow, tests, automation, and existing instruction files because each can affect retained root guidance
Writes CLAUDE.md as exactly @AGENTS.md followed by one newline
Retains the immutable-intent, replay, acceptance, and uncertain-delivery rules supported across the fixture
Runs the packaged validator or records an equivalent manual check without treating structure as semantic proof
Reports material prior-instruction groups and their concrete dispositions without requiring a line-by-line ledger

evals.name: new-polyglot-monorepo-with-nested-guidance
evals.prompt: Bootstrap shared agent guidance for this polyglot monorepo. There is no root AGENTS.md, but two components have their own local instruction files. Keep the root focused on shared truths and do not disturb component-specific rules.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates only the root pair, respects nested precedence, selects repository-wide rules from evidence, and chooses a structure proportional to those rules.

assertions.text: Accounts for nested instruction scope and precedence without overwriting it
Keeps the root guidance repository-wide rather than flattening component-specific rules
Does not create additional nested instruction files
Includes an exact path, command, tool, version, or URL only when evidence shows its literal form materially improves shared root guidance

evals.name: replace-brittle-instructions-with-calibrated-specificity
evals.prompt: Replace the supplied Ledgerbird AGENTS.md. It mixes a machine-local path, pinned library versions, blanket rules, and duplicated checks. Preserve exact details that are stable and useful, remove unsupported or transient constraints, and summarize the material decisions.
evals.expected_output: The replacement keeps the evidenced domain invariants and configured verification commands, removes the machine-local path and unsupported blanket rules, and avoids inheriting the old structure.

assertions.text: Treats the old file as comparison evidence rather than a wording or section template
Retains the exact configured test and lint commands because automation proves their stable behavior-changing value
Removes the machine-local absolute path, unsupported dependency pins, comment-every-function rule, and blanket RetryManager requirement
Does not describe the old file as inferior without evidence
Explains material preserved, reframed, and removed rule groups without manufacturing an exhaustive report

evals.name: negative-wording-with-autonomy
evals.prompt: Create project agent instructions that strongly prevent bypassing tests, swallowing errors, unsafe retries, drive-by cleanup, and speculative abstractions, but still let the coding agent choose the best implementation from local evidence.
evals.expected_output: The generated guidance keeps costly failure boundaries explicit, states the safe outcome and reason, and leaves unearned mechanisms and presentation choices open.

assertions.text: Each material prohibition names the safe or permitted action and why the boundary matters
Reliability rules are conditional on project evidence and operational risk
Does not use repeated urgency, emotional pressure, role-play, or blanket MUST language
Leaves implementation choices open when multiple approaches fit local evidence

evals.name: adjacent-readme-request
evals.prompt: Rewrite the README so new contributors can install the project and understand its command-line examples.
evals.expected_output: The bootstrap skill does not take ownership of an ordinary README rewrite and does not create AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

assertions.text: Does not create or replace persistent agent instruction files
Routes the task as repository documentation work

evals.name: sparse-library-earns-sparse-guidance
evals.prompt: Create root AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md for Pocketcalc, a small arithmetic-expression library. Keep only project knowledge that deserves persistent context. Its public behavior preserves formatted negative zero as -0 for financial importers, formats positive zero as 0, and rejects locale commas rather than normalizing them. The configured checks are bun test and bun run typecheck. The repository currently has no network calls, persistence, deployment, migrations, or background work.
evals.expected_output: A genuinely small AGENTS.md that preserves the signed-zero formatting invariant and exact configured checks without adding generic section boilerplate, plus the exact CLAUDE.md import.

assertions.text: Preserves signed-zero formatting as the non-obvious project invariant
Includes the exact configured test and typecheck commands because they are the repository's shared verification contract
Does not add reliability, operations, deployment, migration, security, or architecture boilerplate absent from the evidence
Does not turn the current absence of network, persistence, deployment, migrations, or background work into permanent prohibitions
Does not force a minimum number of headings, lines, or generic concepts
Writes CLAUDE.md as exactly @AGENTS.md followed by one newline
